answers.purpose: Harit-SANKALP is a portal for discovering forest nurseries and tracking forestry planting material and field workflows.
answers.services: The portal provides nursery discovery and mapping, advance booking, role-based forestry workflows, approvals, and field progress reporting.
answers.registration: Authorized Range Officers can register sites from the internal workflow dashboard. Sign in first, open the relevant registration module, enter site and GPS details, then submit it for the hierarchy approval.
answers.login: Choose your role from the Login menu. National, State, Circle, and DFO officers use the configured PARIVESH login; Range Officers and Silviculturists use their issued workflow accounts.
answers.approval: Workflow approvals follow the hierarchy: DFO reviews Range Officer submissions, Circle reviews DFO submissions, State reviews Circle submissions, and National reviews State submissions. Silviculturist technical assessments are separate from formal approval.
answers.progress: Range Officers submit a site progress report every six months from the internal dashboard. A current GPS fix within 100 metres of the registered site and a current site photo are required. Silviculturists add scientific assessments and recommendations.
answers.spa: A Seed Production Area (SPA) is a managed forest area used to produce seed from selected trees.
answers.cpt: A Candidate Plus Tree (CPT) is a tree selected for desirable growth, form, health, or seed characteristics.
answers.seedOrchard: A Seed Orchard is a plantation of selected trees managed to produce improved seed.
answers.booking: Open Advance Booking, choose a state, district, nursery, and species, then submit the booking form with the required details.
answers.map: Open Our Nurseries or the public dashboard map. Select a state or nursery marker to see the site information and location.

answers.loginForInternal: Sign in with your workflow account to access internal report totals and pending work. I only show records your role is allowed to see.

1.question: What is the purpose of this portal?
1.answer: This portal is a centralized digital platform for planning, traceability and monitoring of forest nurseries and planting material.

2.question: What services does this platform provide?
2.answer: Services include mapping existing nurseries, end-to-end traceability of planting material and unique QR code generation.

3.question: What are the unique features of this platform?
3.answer: The platform provides a unique code for every entity and role-based workflows for different authorities.

4.question: Who can use this platform?
4.answer: Forest departments, nursery managers and authorized government officials can use this platform.

5.question: Is user registration mandatory?
5.answer: Yes. Authorized personnel must register to access the role-based dashboard.

6.question: What is a Seed Production Area (SPA)?
6.answer: A designated area managed specifically to produce high-quality seeds for forestry.

7.question: What is a Candidate Plus Tree (CPT)?
7.answer: An outstanding tree selected for its desirable physical characteristics and potential use in breeding programs.

8.question: What details are required to register a Nursery, SPA/CPT or Seed Orchard?
8.answer: Registration requires location details, available species, capacity and the relevant forest division.

9.question: What is a Seed Orchard?
9.answer: A plantation of genetically superior trees, isolated to reduce pollination from genetically inferior outside sources.

10.question: What is a Seed Processing cum Treatment Unit?
10.answer: A facility where collected seeds are cleaned, treated and prepared for storage or sowing.

about.title: About Harit-SANKALP
about.description: Harit-SANKALP (System for Afforestation, Nursery Knowledge & Linkage Platform) is a digital platform for connecting forest nurseries, planting material, and forestry stakeholders across India.
